note: 每套候选 = 阅读A（近景拿手机）+ 阅读B（半身）+ 一个动作，配成同一个角度和语气，整套选。

candidates.label: A. 无聊打字 → 反差惊喜

lines.text: I used to send the most boring texts ever.
No font, no emojis, just plain words.
Then I found Kika Keyboard. Now I've got crazy fonts, cute stickers and kaomoji in every chat.
lines.tone: <excited, show your chat with Kika Keyboard>

lines.text: Every text I sent looked exactly the same.
Same font, same keyboard, just boring.
Kika Keyboard fixed that in one download.

requirements: Prepare a phone with Kika Keyboard installed and set as the default keyboard.

subactions.title: Action 1 (Boring to magic): (~5-6 seconds)
steps: Sit on the sofa or at a desk. Hold your phone and type with a flat, bored expression on the plain keyboard, then switch to a Kika theme and font, drop in a kaomoji, and hit send with a big grin.
subactions.imageCaption: Reference: switching to a themed keyboard.

candidates.label: B. 十秒改造整部手机

lines.text: I changed my whole phone in like ten seconds.
And no, I didn't buy a new one.
It's Kika Keyboard. Ten thousand plus themes, and you can match it to your lock screen too.
My phone used to look like everyone else's.
Now every time I type, it's a different theme.
Kika Keyboard. Free, and it actually looks good.

requirements: Prepare a phone with Kika Keyboard installed and a theme already downloaded.

subactions.title: Action 1 (Scroll and jaw-drop): (~5-6 seconds)
steps: Hold the phone up in portrait, screen facing you, scroll through themes quickly with your thumb, then stop on a favorite theme, widen your eyes and let your jaw drop while showing the screen to the camera.
subactions.imageCaption: Reference: themed keyboard matched with lock screen.

candidates.label: C. 朋友看到后抢手机

lines.text: My friend saw my keyboard and literally grabbed my phone out of my hand.
She couldn't believe it was free.
It's called Kika Keyboard. Themes, fonts, stickers, kaomoji, all free.
Okay, I'm a little obsessed with my keyboard now.
It's the first thing people notice when I text them.
If your chats feel dry, get Kika.

requirements: Prepare a phone with Kika Keyboard installed and set as the default keyboard.
Shoot with a second person, or mime handing the phone to someone off-camera.

subactions.title: Action 1 (Tap, then reach): (~5-6 seconds)
steps: Hold the phone with the keyboard facing you, tap a few keys with a small smile, tilt it toward an off-camera friend, then mime them reaching in to grab it and react with a surprised laugh.
subactions.imageCaption: Reference: fingers tapping a themed keyboard.
